description: Variation of condition 5 (Secure by Design) of appeal reference: APP/U5360/C/20/3259652 dated 26/03/2024 in relation to extend the time period from 3 months to 10 months

A demolition and construction method statement covering all phases&nbsp;</span><span style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt; white-space-collapse: preserve;">of the development to include details of noise control measures and&nbsp; measures to preserve air quality (including a risk assessment of the demolition and construction phase).</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.656;background-color:#ffffff;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;padding:0pt 0pt 8pt 0pt;"><span style="font-size: 11pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; color: rgb(34, 34, 34); background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-decoration: none; vertical-align: baseline; white-space: pre-wrap;">2.
